s: tri, (marttumicCuH । mf + san + uH .) AsannamftyuH । (yaTA SrImadBAgavate । 7 । 8 । 11 । “vyaktaM tvaM marttukAmo'si yo'timAtraM vikatTase । mumUrzURAM hi mandAtman ! nanu syurviklavA giraH ॥”) aTa mumUrzukftyAni । hArItaH । ‘SUdrAnnena tu Buktena udarasTena yo mftaH । sa vE KaratvamuzwratvaM SUdratvaYcADigacCati ॥’ SUdrAnnaM SUdrasvAmikAnnam । taddattamapi BojanakAle tadgfhAvasTitaM yat tadapi SUdrAnnam । tadAhANgirAH । ‘SUdraveSmani vipreRa kzIraM vA yadi vA daDi । nivfttena na BoktavyaM SUdrAnnaM tadapi smftam ॥’ apiSabdAt sAkzAt taddattaGftataRqulAdi na tu taddattakapardakAdinA krItamapi । svagfhAgate punaraNgirAH । ‘yaTAyatastato hyApaH SudDiM yAnti nadIM gatAH । SUdrAdbipragfhezvannaM pravizwantu sadA Suci ॥’ pravizwaM sattvApAdakapratigrahAdinA iti SezaH । ataeva parASaraH । ‘tAvadBavati SUdrAnnaM yAvanna spfSati dbijaH । dbijAtikarasaMspfzwaM sarvvaM tadDavirucyate ॥’ spfSati pratigfhRAti iti kalpataruH ॥ tacca saMprokzya grAhyamAha vizRupurARam । ‘saMprokzayitvA gfhRIyAcCUdrAnnaM gfhamAgatam .’ tacca pAtrAntare grAhyamAha aNgirAH । ‘svapAtre yattu vinyastaM SUdro yacCati nityaSaH । pAtrAntaragataM grAhyaM dugDaM svagfhamAgatam ॥’ etena svagfhamAgatasyEva SudDatvam । tadgfhagatasya SUdrAnnadozaBAgitvaM pratIyate । tataScEtAdfgapi mumUrzuRA sarvvaTA SUdrAnnaM na Boktavyam ॥ * ॥ pUjAratnAkare । ‘SAlagrAmaSilA yatra tatra sannihito hariH । tatsanniDO tyajet prARAn yAti vizRoH paraM padam ॥’ liNgapurARe । ‘SAlagrAmasamIpe tu kroSamAtraM samantataH । kIkawe'pi mfto yAti vEkuRWaBavanaM naraH ॥’ kIkawo magaDaH ॥ * ॥ vEzRavAmfte vyAsaH । ‘tulasIkAnane jantoryadi mftyurBavet kvacit । sa nirBartsya yamaM pApI lIlayEva hariM viSet ॥ prayARakAle yasyAsye dIyate tulasIdalam । nirvvARaM yAti pakzIndra ! pApakowiyuto'pi saH ॥’ kUrmmapurARam । ‘gaNgAyAYca jale mokzo vArARasyAM jale sTale । jale sTale cAntarIkze gaNgAsAgarasaNgame ॥’ skAnde । ‘gaNgAyAM tyajataH prARAn kaTayAmi varAnane ! । karRe tat paramaM brahma dadAmi mAmakaM padam ॥’ taTA । ‘tIrAdgavyUtimAtrantu paritaH kzetramucyate । atra dAnaM japo homo gaNgAyAM nAtra saMSayaH ॥ atrasTAstridivaM yAnti ye mftAste'punarBavAH ॥’ gavyUtiH kroSayugam । tIrTacintAmaRO brahmapurARam । ‘atra dUre samIpe ca sadfSaM yojanadbayam । gaNgAyAM maraReneha nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥’ * ॥ evaM gaNgAdimaraRena prAptabrahmalokasyApyOrdDadehikI kriyA tadaDikAriRA karttavyA nityatvAt । taTA ca SrImadBAgavate । ‘kfzRa evaM Bagavati manovAkdfzwivfttiBiH । AtmanyAtmAnamAveSya so'ntaHSvAsamupAramat ॥ saMpadyamAnamAjYAya BIzmaM brahmaRi nizkale । sarvve baBUvuste tUzRIM vayAMsIva dinAtyaye ॥ tasya nirharaRAdIni saMparetasya BArgava ! । yuDizWiraH kArayitvA muhUrttaM duHKito'Bavat ॥’ kfzRe Atmani paramAtmani AtmAnaM svIyAtmAnaM niveSya ekIkftya sa BIzmaH upAramat muktiM gatavAn । nizkale nirupADO brahmaRi saMpadyamAnaM militaM AjYAya Alakzya tasya BIzmasya nirharaRAdIni saMskArAdIni saMparetasya samyak paretasya muktasyApi । BArgaveti SOnakasya samboDanam । evaYca etezAmapi tattatkarmmaRi tattadvacanopAttapretapadasya pitfpadasya ca mantrAdizu yaTAyaTaM vAcanikatvAt prayogaH saNgacCate । ‘AsannamftyunA deyA gOH savatsA ca pUrvvavat । tadaBAve ca gOrekA narakodDAraRAya vE ॥ tadA yadi na Saknoti dAtuM vEtaraRIYca gAm । Sakto'nyo'ruk tadA dattvA Sreyo dadyAnmftaMsya ca ॥’ pUrvvavadDemaSfNgAdinA । atra mftasya ceti SravaRAt ekAdaSAhe'pi vEtaraRIdAnAcAraH । vanaparvvaRi । ‘sArTaH pravasato mitraM BAryyA mitraM gfhe sataH । Aturasya BizaNmitraM dAnaM mitraM marizyataH ॥’ varAhapurARe । “vyatIpAto'Ta saMkrAntistaTEva grahaRaM raveH । puRyakAlAstadA sarvve yadA mftyurupasTitaH ॥ goBUtilahiraRyAdi dattamakzayatAmiyAt ॥” niravakASatvAdatra malamAsAdidozo nAsti sUtakamapi na । taTA ca SudDiratnAkare dakzaH । “susTakAle tvidaM sarvvaM sUtakaM parikIrttitam । Apadgatasya sarvvasya sUtake'pi na sUtakam ॥” iti SudDitattvam ॥

s: puM, (moktumicCatIti । muc + san + uH .) muktimicCaH ॥ (yaTA, SrImadBagavadgItAyAm । 4 । 15 । “evaM jYAtvA kftaM karmma pUrvvErapi mumukzuBiH । kuru karmmEva tasmAttvaM pUrvvEH pUrvvataraM kftam ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । SramaRaH 2 yatiH 3 vAcaMyamaH 4 vratI 5 sADuH 6 anagAraH 7 fzi, 8 muniH 9 nirgranTaH 10 BikzuH 11 । iti hemacandraH 1 । 75 ॥ aTa mumukzukftyam । manuH । “iha cAmutra vA kAmyaM pravfttaM karmma kIrttyate । nizkAmaM jYAnapUrvvantu nivfttamupadiSyate ॥ pravfttaM karmma saMsevya devAnAmeti sArzwitAm । nivfttaM mevamAnastu BUtAnyatyeti paYca vE ॥” kAmanApUrvvakaM karmma SarIrapravfttihetutvAt pravftta tadeva karmma kAmanArahitaM punarbrahmajYAnAByAsapUrvvakaM saMsAranivfttihetutvAt nivfttamucyate । sArzwitAM samAnagatitAM fzergatyarTatvAt paYcaBUtAnyatyeti atikrAmati mokzaM prApnotItyarTaH । vizRupurARe ca । 6 । 7 । 38 । viSizwaPaladA kAmyA nizkAmARAYca muktidA । BagavadgItApi । “yuktaH karmmaPalaM tyaktvA SAntimApnoti nEzWikIm । ayuktaH kAmakAreRa Pale sakto nibaDyate ॥” yuktaH ISvarAya karmmARi na PalAya ityevaM samAhitaH । PalaM tyaktvA karmmARi kurvvanniti SezaH । SAntiM mokzAKyAM nEzWikIM nizWAyAM BavAm । sattvaSudDiH jYAnaprAptiH sarvvakarmmasaMnyAsaH jYAnanizWAkrameReti vAkyaSezaH । ayuktastadvahirmmuKaH । kAmakAreRa kAmapreritatayA kAmataH pravftteriti yAvat । Pale saktaH san PalAyedaM karmma karomItyevaM Pale sakto nitarAM banDaM prApnoti । taTA ca arjjunaM prati BagavadbAkyam । “mayi sarvvARi karmmARi saMnyasyADyAtmacetasA । nirASIrnirmamo BUtvA yuDyasva vigatajvaraH ॥” saMnyasya niHkzipya samarpya iti yAvat । aDyAtmacetasA vivekabudDyA ISvarAya Bftyavat karomi ityanayA budDyA nirASIstyaktakAmasaNkalpaH । ataeva nirmmamaH mamatArahitaH । vigatajvaraH vigatasantApaH । vyaktamAha sa eva । “yat karozi yadaSnAsi yajjuhozi dadAsi yat । yat tapasyasi kOnteya ! tat kuruzva madarpaRam ॥” vizRupurARam । “karmmARyasaNkalpitatatPalAni saMnyasya vizRO paramAtmarUpe । avApya tAM karmmamahImanante tasmin layaM ye tvamalAH prayAnti ॥” karmmamahIM BAratavarzarUpAm । ekAdaSaskanDe । “vedoktameva kurvvARo niHsaNgo'rpitumISvare । nEzkarmyAM laBate sidDiM rocanArTA PalaSrutiH ॥” vedoktameva kurvvARo na tu nizidDam । nanu karmmaRikriyamARe tasminnAsaktitastatPalaM syAdeva na tu nEzkarmmyarUpA PalasidDirata evAha niHsaNgo'naBiniveSavAn ISvare'rpituM na tu PaloddeSena । aTa Palasya SrutatvAt karmmaRi kfte PalaM Bavatyeva ityAha rocanArTeti karmmaRi rucyutpAdanArTA । ataeva tatrEva । “PalaSrutiriyaM nFRAM na Sreyo rocanaM param । SreyovivakzayA proktA yaTA BEzajyarocanam ॥ utpattyEva hi kAmezu prARezu svajanezu ca । Asaktamanaso marttyA Atmano'narTahetuzu ॥ na tAnaviduzaH svArTaM BrAmyato vfjinADvani । kaTaM yuYjyAt punastezu tAMstamo viSato buDaH ॥ evaM vyavasitaM kecidavijYAya kubudDvayaH । PalaSrutiM kusumitAM na vedajYA vadanti hi ॥” iyaM PalaSrutirna SreyaHparamapuruzArTaparA na Bavati kintu bahirmuKAnAM nFRAM mokzavivakzayA avAntarakarmmaPalEH karmmasu rucyutpAdanamAtraM yaTA, BEzajye OzaDe rucyutpAdanam । yaTA, -- “piba nimbaM pradAsyAmi Kalu te KaRqalaqqukAn । pitrEvamuktaH pibati na PalaM tAvadeva tu ॥” tatrAgadapAnasya na Kalu KaRqAdilABa eva prayojanaM kintvArogyam । taTA vedo'pyavAntaraPalEH praloBayan mokzAyEva karmmARi viDatte । nanu karmmakARqe mokzasya nAmApi na SrUyate kaTamevaM vyAKyAyate yaTASrutasyEva GawanAt ityAha utpattyeti dvAByAm । utpattyA svaBAvata eva kAmezu paSvAdizu prARezu AyurindriyabalavIryyAdizu svajanezu puttradArAdizu anarTahetuzu paripAkato duHKahetuzu atastAn svArTaM paramasuKamaviduzaH ajAnataH ato na tAn prahvIBUtAn buDo vedo yadboDayati tadeva SreyaH iti viSvasitAn ityarTaH । tAn evamBUtAn vfjinADvani kAmavartmani devAdiyonO BrAmyataH tataH punastamoBUtavfkzAdiyoniM viSata iti । paSukAma iti ca suKaputtrAdikAma iti ca kaTaM punastezveva kAmezu ayaM buDo vedo yuYjyAt pravarttayet । taTA satyanAptaH syAt iti BAvaH । kaTaM tarhi karmmamImAMsakAH PalaparatAM vadanti tatrAha । evamiti vyavasitaM vedasyABiprAyaM avijYAya kusumitAmavAntaraPalarocanayA ramaRIyAM paramaPalaSrutiM vadanti kutaste kubudDayastatrAha hi yasmAt vedajYA vyAsAdayaH na taTA vadanti iti । ataeva nizkAmakarmmaRa AtmajYAnArTatoktA yaTA, -- “ayameva kriyAyogo jYAnayogasya sADakaH । karmmayogaM vinA jYAnaM kasyacinneha dfSyate ॥” so'pi duritakzayadbArA na sAkzAt । taTA ca । “jYAnamutpadyate puMsAM kzayAt pApasya karmmaRaH ॥” taTA SrutiH । “tamevaM vedArTavacanena brAhmaRA vividizanti brahmacaryyeRa tapasA SradDayA dAnenayajYenAnaSanena ceti .” taM AtmatattvasAkzAtkAraM ataeva yajYAdInAM jYAnaSezatAYcAvaDAryya nizkAmezu karmmasu pravarttate । paRqitenApi mUrKaH kAmye karmmaRi na pravarttayitavya ityAha zazWaskanDe । “svayaM niHSreyasaM vidvAnnavaktyajYAya karmma hi । na rAti rogiRe'paTyaM vAYCate'pi BizaktamaH ॥” rAti dadAti iti samayapradIpe SrIdattaH ॥ “dAsIdAsamalaNkAramannaM zaqrasasamBavam । puruzottamatuzwyarTaM pradeyaM sArvvakAlikam ॥ yadyadizwatamaM loke yaccApyasti gfhe Suci । tattadDi deyaM prItyarTaM devadevasya cakriRaH ॥” idaM dAnaM brAhyaRasampradAnakameva vizRuprItimuddiSya evaM sarvvatra dAne । vizRuprIteH sAmAnyataH SrutatvAt । aTa vizRuprItO devatADikaraRanyAyaviroDa iti cenna svargavadaDikAriviSezaRatvena tatsattvaprasADanAt ityAhuH । brAhmaRasampradAnakatve kiM mAnamiti cet vAmanapurARe tattanmAsaBedena tattaddAnamaBiDAya । “vizRuprItyarTametAni deyAni brAhmaRezvaTa । deyAni vipramuKyeByo maDusUdanatuzwaye ॥” ityaBiDAya dAsIdAsamityAdivacanadbayABiDAnAt । taTA ca vizRuDarmmottarAgnipurARayoH । “yatra yatra Bavet prItirvizayeByo mahAmune ! । tattadacyutamuddiSya vipreByaH pratipAdayet ॥” vizRuDarmmottaratftIyakARqe tu vizRusaMpradAnakameva dAnaM yaTA, -- ‘vizRoH SaNKapradAnena vAruRaM lokamApnuyAt .’ ityAdinA । “kzIrapallavasaMyuktAn kalasAn suviBUzitAn । dattvA vE devadevAya vAjimeDaPalaM laBet ॥” ityantena tattat PalaM tattaddAnamaBiDAyoktam । “akAmaH sAtviko loko yatkiYcidvinivedayet । tenEva sTAnamApnoti yatra gatvA na Socati ॥ DarmmabARijikA mUQAH PalakAmA narADamAH । arccayanti jagannATaM te kAmAnApnuvantyuta ॥ antavattu PalaM tezAM tadBavatyalpameDasAm ॥” taTA । “padByAM pratIcCate devaH sakAmena niveditam । mUrdDnA pratIcCate dattamakAmena dvijottamAH ॥” uktavAmanapurARavacane sArvvakAlikamityanena malamAsAdAvapi vizRuprItyarTaM deyamiti । iti malamAsatattvam ॥ (tatra mumukzatAmudayanAni vyAKyAsyAmaH । tatra lokadozadarSino mumukzorAdita evAcAryyABigamanaM tasyopadeSAnuzWAnam । agnerevopacaryyA DarmmaSAstrAnugamanaM tadarTAvaboDastenAvazwamBastatra yaToktAH kriyAH satAmupAsanamasatAM parivarjjanaM na saNgatirdurjjanena satyaM sarvvaBUtahitamaparuzamanatikAle parIkzya vacanaM sarvvaprARizu AtmanIvAvekzA sarvvAsAmasmaraRamasaNkalpanamaprArTanA anaBiBAzaRaYca strIRAM sarvvaparigrahatyAgaH kOpInaM pracCAdanArTaM DAturAganivasanaM kanTAsIvanahetoH sUcI pippalakaM SOcADAnahetoH jalakuRqikA daRqaDAraRaM BakzyAcaryyArTapAtraM prARaDAraRArTamekakAlamagrAmyo yaTopapanna evAByavahAraH । SramApanayanArTaM SIrRaSuzkaparRatfRAstaraRopaDAnaM DyAnahetoH kAyanibanDanaM vanezvaniketavAsaH tandrAnidrAlasyAdikarmmavarjjanaM indriyArTezvanurAgopatApanigrahaH suptasTitagataprekzitAhAravihArapratyaNgacezwAdikezvAramBezu smftipUrvvikA pravfttiH satkArastutigarhAvamAnakzamatvaM kzutpipAsAyAsaSramaSItozRavAtavarzAsuKaduHKasaMsparSasahatvaM SokadEnyadvezamadamAnaloBarAgerzyABayakroDAdiBirasaYcalanaM ahaNkArAdizUpasargasaMjYA lokapuruzayoH svargAdisAmAnyAvekzaRaM kAryyakAlAtyayaBayaM yogAramBe satatamanirvvedaH sattvotsAho'pavargAya DIDftismftibalADAnaM niyamanamindriyARAM cetasi cetasa AtmanyAtmanaSca DAtuBedena SarIrAvayavasaMKyAnaM aBIkzRaM sarvvaM kAraRavadduHKamasvamanityamityaByupagamaH । sarvvapravfttizu duHKasaMjYA sarvvasaMnyAse suKamityaBiniveSaH ezamArgo'pavargAya ato'nyaTA baDyate ityudayanAni vyAKyAtAni ॥ iti carake SArIrasTAne paYcame'DyAye ॥)
m: मुमुक्षु mfn. desirous of freeing, wishing to deliver from (abl.), MBh.
eager to be free (from mundane existence), striving after emancipation, RV.; Up. &c.
wishing to let go or give up (acc.), Kathās.
wishing to discharge or shed or emit or shoot or hurl or send forth (acc. or comp.), MBh.; Ragh.
मुमुक्षु m. a sage who strives after emancipation, W.
a: मुमुक्षु — a. 1 Desirous of releasing or liberating. --2 Wishing to discharge. --3 About to shoot (arrows &c.); R. 9. 58. --4 Wishing to be free from worldly existence, striving after final emancipation. --क्षुः A sage striving after final emancipation or beatitude; अंतर्यश्च मुमुक्षुभिर्नियमितप्राणादिभिर्मृग्यते V. 1. 1; Ku. 2. 51; Bg. 4. 15.
